summary: Remote PTY backdoor with Anthropic API key harvesting via wss://relay.sextant.top
details: The shipped Go binary bin/sxt establishes an interactive remote shell by connecting to a hardcoded WebSocket relay wss://relay.sextant.top and wiring the socket to a PTY (github.com/creack/pty + github.com/coder/websocket), giving the relay operator interactive shell control of the installer's host. The same binary embeds a regex matching Anthropic API keys (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}), references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, and harvests sk-ant-* credentials from the installer's Claude configuration. It also queries http://ip-api.com/json/ for country, city, timezone, ISP, org, AS, proxy, hosting, and mobile fields to fingerprint the host, and embeds https://claude.ai/install.sh and https://registry.npmjs.org/sextant-cli/latest together with strings such as 'userrootsudocurlpull.new' and 'dauthbrew.zip' consistent with runtime fetch-and-execute of shell installers under the relay's direction. The package.json license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, aligning the publisher identity with control of Claude accounts.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
